note.label: Mark 7: The Tradition of the Elders and What Defiles a Man

points: This is under the Roman Empire. Rome has already absorbed the Greek Empire; that's why by this time it's called the Greco-Roman Empire.

In the Greek the word is Hellen, number 1672. A Greek by nationality, but in a wider sense all nations, not Jews, who made the language, customs and learning of the Greeks their own, and the primary reference is to a difference of religion and worship. So a Greek was not only one born Greek: whoever took up the religion and worship of the Greeks became a Greek.

“And further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.” Those Greeks were Hellenized Jews, Greek-speaking Jews. Greeks and Grecians are to be distinguished: Grecians were Greek-speaking Jews.
